targets.query:
from(bucket:"qualidade_ar")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qualidade_ar" and (r._field == "pm25" or r._field == "pm10"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket:"qualidade_ar")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qualidade_ar" and (r._field == "temperatura"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket:"qualidade_ar")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qualidade_ar" and (r._field == "humidade"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket:"qualidade_ar")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qualidade_ar" and (r._field == "pressao"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket:"qualidade_ar")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qualidade_ar" and (r._field == "pm25"))
  |> last()

from(bucket:"qualidade_ar")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qualidade_ar" and (r._field == "pm25_raw" or r._field == "pm25"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
